name: hypermark
description: Interactive Plan Review for Claude Code - annotate plans visually, share with team, automatically send feedback
author: ahmadghoniem

scripts.build: bun run build:review && bun run build:hook
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ui/tsconfig.strict-consumer.json
scripts.lint:tw: eslint packages/ui --max-warnings 0 && eslint packages/editor --max-warnings 0 && eslint packages/review-editor --max-warnings 0 && eslint apps/hook --max-warnings 0 && eslint apps/review --max-warnings 0
scripts.lint:tw:fix: eslint packages/ui --fix && eslint packages/editor --fix && eslint packages/review-editor --fix && eslint apps/hook --fix && eslint apps/review --fix
